defectsAndFindings: Finding (verified): RuntimeReservationCommand cannot populate the columns its specified row requires. 06 F08-3 says ServeAgentCoordination.Reserve writes serve.agent_runtime_instances, but that table requires fabric_resource_set_id, data_attachment_contract and a full deployment_descriptor with digest and object ref, while the command carries only capability_version_id, artifact and descriptor digest/object ref. Reserve therefore stays unimplemented rather than writing an invalid row; the fix is a contract decision.

Finding (verified): whether Serve is the claimant of the capability_version reference claim is unresolved. 02 says reference_claims covers F08/F10 and allows a capability_version target, and F10 step 3 says Serve acquires it, but Capability accepts only a BUILD claimant (peer gate + purpose hardcoded 'build') and reads owner commit/claim usage through Build-specific clients.

Finding (verified, shared): ownerservice.Authorizer collates every CloudIdentity error into codes.Unavailable, so a policy denial is indistinguishable from an outage at every owner boundary. Fails closed; handed to the shared integrator.

Scope note: serve.agent_runtime_instances.data_attachment_contract is Serve's own column and 02 declares no source shape, so Serve records the opaque attachment identity it was given as {"attachmentId": ...}; it is not a contract for another owner's fact.
